description: This file is a shell script that measures the performance of Git index operations such as read-tree and status, with logic to set up test repositories and configure sparse-checkout for testing different repository states.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up a default repository environment for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with a label and a sequence of shell commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
